system_name: Atlas OS Supreme — Self-Learning Loop (SLL) v1.0
principle: Every completed task must produce organizational knowledge. Future agents must reuse this knowledge automatically. The organization learns faster than any individual agent.

auto_trigger: Task status changes to 'Completed' in Task Tracker
manual_trigger: Agent flags unexpected discovery during task execution
Agent identifies reusable pattern worth documenting
suppressed_trigger: Task was a routine maintenance with no novel learning
Task was aborted before meaningful execution
Task was a duplicate of previously captured knowledge (detected by Memory Architect)

lessons_learned.description: What worked, what didn't, and why

template.category: technical | business | operational | security | marketing | legal | product
template.root_cause: Why did it happen? (5 Whys analysis)
applicability: Which domains/agents does this apply to?
evidence: Links to tasks, commits, logs, metrics
template.author: agent_id

lessons_learned.quality_gate: Must include root cause analysis. Must link to evidence. Must specify applicability.

best_practices.description: Proven approaches that should become standard

template.category: coding | architecture | security | marketing | operations | design | communication
template.title: Short, actionable title
template.rationale: Why this is the best way
examples: Code snippets, campaign templates, process flows
template.author: agent_id
template.adoption_count: How many agents have used this

best_practices.quality_gate: Must be reproducible. Must include anti-patterns. Must have >0.7 confidence. Must be reviewed by 2+ agents.

reusable_components.description: Code, templates, configurations, or designs that can be reused across tasks

template.type: code_module | config_template | design_pattern | prompt_template | workflow | integration_adapter | test_suite | documentation_template
template.name: Human-readable name
template.description: What it does and when to use it
template.content: The actual reusable artifact (or link to artifact)

reusable_components.quality_gate: Must be tested. Must have usage examples. Must specify dependencies. Must be versioned.

architecture_improvements.description: Proposed changes to system architecture based on operational experience
architecture_improvements.quality_gate: Must include migration plan. Must quantify benefits and risks. Must be reviewed by CTO Agent + affected architects.

optimization_ideas.quality_gate: Must be measurable. Must include experiment design. Must quantify ROI.

security_improvements.quality_gate: Must be reviewed by Security Engineer + CSO Agent. Critical severity auto-escalates to incident response.

template.metric: Latency | Throughput | Error Rate | Resource Usage | Scalability
template.author: agent_id

performance_improvements.quality_gate: Must include baseline and target. Must specify validation method. Must be reviewed by Performance Engineer.

template.business_metric: Revenue | Profit | CAC | LTV | Churn | NPS | Market Share
template.author: agent_id

business_improvements.quality_gate: Must quantify opportunity size. Must include risk assessment. Must be reviewed by CFO Agent or CMO Agent.

stage_1_extraction.input: Task execution log, artifacts, metrics, agent working memory
process: Learning Agent analyzes task trajectory: what was planned vs. what happened
Prompt Engineer structures the extraction using domain-specific templates
LLM-based extraction generates draft outputs for all 7 knowledge types
Agent reviews and confirms/corrects auto-extracted insights
Drafts are scored for quality and completeness
stage_1_extraction.output: Draft knowledge artifacts (LL, BP, RC, AI, OI, SI, PI, BI)

process: Research Agent enriches insights with external context (industry benchmarks, research papers, competitor practices)
Knowledge Graph Agent links new insights to existing knowledge: identifies contradictions, confirmations, and gaps
Related historical lessons are auto-attached for context
Confidence scores are adjusted based on external validation and internal consistency
Anti-patterns and counter-examples are identified from failed approaches in memory
stage_2_enrichment.output: Enriched knowledge artifacts with context and confidence adjustments

process: Model Evaluation Agent scores each artifact on: accuracy, completeness, actionability, novelty, evidence quality
Artifacts scoring < 0.6 are rejected with feedback for improvement
Artifacts scoring 0.6-0.8 require peer validation: 2+ agents from different departments review and approve
Artifacts scoring > 0.8 are fast-tracked to publication
Security and architecture improvements are additionally reviewed by CSO Agent and CTO Agent respectively
stage_3_validation.output: Validated knowledge artifacts with approval stamps
stage_3_validation.sla: 4 hours after stage 2 (fast-track); 24 hours for peer review

process: Memory Architect classifies and tags each artifact for discoverability
Vector DB Engineer generates embeddings and stores in appropriate namespace
Knowledge Graph Agent creates/updates entities and relationships
Document Store Engineer archives full documents with version control
Procedural Memory is updated if new SOPs or runbooks are created
API endpoints are updated to include new knowledge in retrieval results
stage_4_publication.output: Published knowledge in organizational memory (all 4 layers)

process: Automation Agent identifies which agents are currently working on related tasks and pushes relevant knowledge to their ASTM
Department Chiefs receive digest of new knowledge relevant to their domain
Weekly Knowledge Digest is generated and distributed to all agents
Critical security or architecture knowledge triggers immediate all-hands notification
New best practices are incorporated into agent training curricula by Training Agent
stage_5_distribution.output: Knowledge distributed to relevant agents and systems
stage_5_distribution.sla: Immediate for critical; daily for high priority; weekly for standard

process: Learning Agent tracks: how often each knowledge item is retrieved, how often it's applied, and the outcomes of application
Business Intelligence correlates knowledge adoption with KPI improvements
Low-adoption knowledge is analyzed: is it not discoverable, not relevant, or not actionable?
High-impact knowledge is promoted to 'Organizational Canon' — immutable best practices
Superseded knowledge is marked deprecated but preserved for historical context
Quarterly report on organizational learning velocity is generated for CEO
stage_6_feedback_loop.output: Knowledge utility metrics + organizational learning report

quality_gates.completeness_check: All required fields populated? Evidence links valid?
quality_gates.accuracy_check: Factual claims supported by evidence? No contradictions with validated knowledge?
quality_gates.actionability_check: Can another agent act on this knowledge without additional research?
quality_gates.novelty_check: Is this genuinely new, or a duplicate of existing knowledge? (Similarity < 0.85 with existing)
quality_gates.security_check: Does this knowledge expose sensitive information? Is classification correct?
quality_gates.bias_check: Is the knowledge free from agent-specific biases? Would another agent reach the same conclusion?

agent_kpi_impact.best_practice_adopted: +5 points per adoption by another agent

evolution_triggers.specialization_split: When an agent consistently produces knowledge in a subdomain > 60% of the time, a new specialized agent is proposed
evolution_triggers.capability_upgrade: When an agent's knowledge contribution score exceeds threshold for 3 consecutive months, model/role upgrade is proposed
evolution_triggers.role_expansion: When an agent's knowledge spans > 3 departments consistently, cross-functional role is proposed
evolution_triggers.deprecation: When an agent's knowledge contribution drops below threshold for 6 months, role review is triggered

organizational_learning_velocity.definition: Number of validated knowledge artifacts produced per week per 100 agents

knowledge_reuse_rate.definition: Percentage of new tasks where relevant organizational knowledge is retrieved and applied

knowledge_retrieval_accuracy.definition: Percentage of retrievals where the top-3 results are rated 'relevant' by the requesting agent

time_to_knowledge.definition: Average time from task start to retrieval of applicable organizational knowledge

knowledge_half_life.definition: Time until 50% of knowledge in a domain is superseded by new learning
knowledge_half_life.target: > 6 months (stable foundations) for architecture; < 2 weeks for marketing tactics
